upstream.note: Structured incident metadata + factual summaries; every row deep-links the original.

incidents.title: CIA, ODNI, NGA: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. The CIA, ODNI and NGA reported a cybersecurity breach that exposed some unclassified information. Officials said no classified data was compromised and the attackers have not been identified. United States.

incidents.title: Valley Family Health Care: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Valley Family Health Care, Inc. reported a data breach to the California Attorney General with names exposed. Notification letters were sent via IDX to affected individuals. Los Angeles, United States.

incidents.title: Telecare Health: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Telecare Health notified 19,922 Washington residents of a data breach where names were exposed. Letters were sent via IDX to inform affected individuals. Seattle, United States.

incidents.title: Phreesia: Confirmed supply chain attack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Phreesia, Inc. disclosed a vendor breach linked to the Salesloft Drift supply-chain incident, affecting 100,000 people with SSNs and medical data exposed. Letters were sent via Kroll. Denver, United States.

incidents.title: Markt Buttenheim: Reported cyberattack, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 25 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. The German municipality of Markt Buttenheim reported an IT security incident that left the town hall's IT infrastructure largely unavailable. The town published a notice about the outage. Germany.

incidents.title: Vincci Hotels: Claimed by Black X, not confirmed
incidents.description: Black X claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 25 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The ransomware group Black X claimed Spanish hotel group Vincci Hotels as a victim on its leak site. The claim was not confirmed by the company. Spain.

incidents.title: sunnybrook.ca: Claimed by Scarlettgroup, not confirmed
incidents.description: Scarlettgroup claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 24 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The Scarlettgroup group listed sunnybrook.ca on its leak site. The organisation has not confirmed an attack, so treat this as a claim. Canada.

incidents.title: Elmet Group: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Elmet Group Co. filed a Form 8-K with the SEC on 2026-11-24 that discusses a cybersecurity incident. Read the filing for scope and impact. Portland, United States.

incidents.title: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. FinCEN experienced unauthorized access to a limited subset of its systems, leading to a partial service outage and disruption of financial‑regulatory reporting. The agency has confirmed the cyber incident and taken precautionary system shutdowns while restoring services. Tysons, United States.

incidents.title: JAXA: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. JAXA disclosed that its Earth observation data publishing system was accessed without authorization, resulting in the leakage of account names and encrypted passwords for about 2,000 users. The agency confirmed the breach, halted the service, and is removing the backdoor and fixing the vulnerability. Chōfu, Japan.

incidents.title: Deichmann SE: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Deichmann SE disclosed that unauthorized parties accessed selected customer data on its online shop. The company confirmed the breach, informed authorities and stated that no evidence of data misuse has been found. Essen, Germany.

incidents.title: ODNI: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. The Office of the Director of National Intelligence was named alongside the CIA as affected in the same intrusion. ODNI stated there was no impact to critical functions or classified systems. Washington, United States.

incidents.title: Todoist / Doist: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Todoist disclosed that an attacker used stolen credentials to download account records for about 6% of users, including emails and salted password hashes. The notice was published on November 24. San Francisco, United States.

incidents.title: Keio: Confirmed ransomware attack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Keio Corporation announced that a ransomware attack detected in September may have leaked personal information on up to 11.08 million people, including copies of identity documents and credit card numbers. Roughly 12,300 customers and job applicants were confirmed in a separate disclosure the same day. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: WELEDA Japan: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. WELEDA Japan disclosed that credit card information of more than 45,600 people may have leaked following a cyber incident. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Allied Media / Allied Press: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. New Zealand newspaper publisher Allied Media / Allied Press reported on 24 November 2026 that production systems were disrupted and distribution of several regional newspapers was delayed. No attacker was identified. Dunedin, New Zealand.

incidents.title: KodeKloud: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. KodeKloud disclosed that an intruder entered an internal reporting tool on November 10 by exploiting a software vulnerability, exposing names, emails, usernames, marketing preferences, last-login times and job titles. No passwords or card details were reached. India.

incidents.title: Banco do Brasil: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Banco do Brasil told some account holders that third parties had improper access to personal data in November, including name, CPF, email, branch number and in some cases account number. No intrusion of internal systems occurred. Brasília, Brazil.

incidents.victim: CIA / Office of the Director of National Intelligence
incidents.title: CIA / Office of the Director of National Intelligence: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. The CIA and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence discovered a cybersecurity breach of a network used to search public unclassified material for intelligence insights. The ODNI said there were no disruptions to critical capabilities or classified systems, and information at other government agencies was also believed exposed. United States.

incidents.title: Kauenet (Kokuyo group): Confirmed supply chain attack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Kokuyo group e-commerce unit Kauenet said on 24 November 2026 that a breach of the Plaid marketing platform KARTE exposed 300,525 records after de-duplication. The company published a second report on the incident. Japan.

incidents.title: CIA and ODNI: Reported data breach, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 24 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. The CIA and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence experienced a data breach of an unclassified intelligence analysis system. CyberScoop confirmed the breach and a source said no other systems are currently at risk. United States.

incidents.title: Coborn's: Reported data breach, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 24 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. Coborn's, Inc. had its class-action investigation updated on November 24; unauthorized network access occurred between November 30 and December 1, 2025. Sensitive personally identifiable information may have been exposed. Des Moines, United States.

incidents.title: eCitizen: Claimed by ByteToBreach, not confirmed
incidents.description: ByteToBreach claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 24 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. Hackers claiming to be ByteToBreach said they stole about 740 GB of data from Kenya’s eCitizen platform. The Kenyan government and the platform have not confirmed the breach. Kenya.

incidents.title: CSG Systems International: Claimed by Falcon, not confirmed
incidents.description: Falcon claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 24 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. CSG Systems International was named in a Falcon ransomware leak-site post claiming 1.3 TB of data extracted. No encryption or ransom amount was stated by the group. Plano, United States.

incidents.title: Kegler, Brown, Hill & Ritter: Claimed by SilentRansomGroup, not confirmed
incidents.description: SilentRansomGroup claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 24 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. Kegler, Brown, Hill & Ritter was listed by SilentRansomGroup on its leak site on November 24. The listing contains no substantive description of the organization or incident details. Columbus, United States.

incidents.title: Nonigman LLP: Claimed by SilentRansomGroup, not confirmed
incidents.description: SilentRansomGroup claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 24 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. Nonigman LLP was listed by SilentRansomGroup on its leak site on November 24. The available information does not identify the industry, location, or business activities of the firm. United States.

incidents.title: Greenbaum, Rowe, Smith & Davis: Claimed by SilentRansomGroup, not confirmed
incidents.description: SilentRansomGroup claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 24 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. Greenbaum, Rowe, Smith & Davis was listed by SilentRansomGroup on its leak site on November 24. The listing provides no further details regarding the incident or data exposure. Westbury, United States.

incidents.title: Indian Institute of Management Raipur: Claimed by Pixelleaks, not confirmed
incidents.description: Pixelleaks claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 24 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The ransomware group Pixelleaks claimed a cyberattack against the Indian Institute of Management Raipur, alleging access to personnel and operational records. The claim was posted to a leak site and not confirmed by the institution. Raipur, India.

incidents.title: National Knowledge Network (NKN Delhi PoP): Claimed by Pixelleaks, not confirmed
incidents.description: Pixelleaks claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 24 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The ransomware group Pixelleaks claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against the National Knowledge Network's Delhi point of presence and threatened to publish sensitive business records. The claim was posted on November 24, 2026, and was not confirmed by the organisation. New Delhi, India.

incidents.title: Kneron: Claimed by SafePay, not confirmed
incidents.description: SafePay claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 24 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The ransomware group SafePay listed San Diego-based AI technology company Kneron Inc. as a victim on its leak site on 24 November 2026. The company had not confirmed the claim. San Diego, United States.

incidents.title: Foundations Investment Advisors: Claimed by Incransom, not confirmed
incidents.description: Incransom claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 24 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The ransomware group Incransom claimed responsibility on 24 November 2026 for an attack on US investment advisory firm Foundations Investment Advisors LLC, threatening to release data. The firm had not confirmed the claim. United States.

incidents.title: Rilievi Group: Claimed by Eclipse, not confirmed
incidents.description: Eclipse claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 24 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The ransomware operation Eclipse listed Italian garment company Rilievi Group as a victim on 24 November 2026. The company had not confirmed the claim. Italy.

incidents.title: Lambert Somec: Claimed by Secp0, not confirmed
incidents.description: Secp0 claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 24 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The ransomware group Secp0 listed Quebec construction company Lambert Somec as a victim on 24 November 2026. The company had not confirmed the claim. Canada.

incidents.title: Coneco Engineers & Scientists: Claimed by Aoqin, not confirmed
incidents.description: Aoqin claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 24 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The emerging ransomware group Aoqin listed US professional services firm Coneco Engineers & Scientists as a victim on 24 November 2026 with an estimated attack date of the same day and 10 GB claimed exfiltrated. The claim was unverified and the firm had not confirmed it. United States.

incidents.title: Home Instead: Claimed by Anubis, not confirmed
incidents.description: Anubis claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 24 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The ransomware group Anubis listed US home care provider Home Instead as a victim on its leak site on 24 November 2026. The company had not confirmed the claim. United States.

incidents.title: Innovation Industries: Claimed by Aurora, not confirmed
incidents.description: Aurora claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 24 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The ransomware group Aurora listed Arkansas manufacturer Innovation Industries, Inc. as a victim on its leak site on 24 November 2026. The company had not confirmed the claim. Russellville, United States.

incidents.title: US county government website (unnamed): Claimed by Soulgroup, not confirmed
incidents.description: Soulgroup claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 24 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The group Soulgroup claimed a US county government website as a ransomware victim on 24 November 2026. The county was not named and no government body had confirmed the claim. United States.

incidents.title: Suisun City: Confirmed ransomware attack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. In August, Suisun City’s computer network was encrypted by ransomware attackers, forcing the city to shut down services and declare a state of emergency. The city manager confirmed the attack and the ongoing recovery effort. Suisun, United States.

incidents.title: Bromcom: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Hackers accessed Bromcom's legacy SSO component and extracted over 355,000 school staff and pupil email addresses. Bromcom confirmed the breach, stating no passwords or pupil records were stolen. Beckenham, United Kingdom.

incidents.title: Hana Savings Bank: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. An unauthorized external intrusion into Hana Savings Bank's mobile web customer verification system leaked personal credit information of 552 customers. The bank has confirmed the data breach and notified the affected customers on November 19. South Korea.

incidents.title: Rolla School District: Reported cyberattack, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 24 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. A computer-generated threatening voicemail was sent to multiple buildings in the Rolla School District on Sunday night. The district and Rolla Police Department say the message is part of a nationwide spam/threat call and is not considered credible. Rolla, United States.

incidents.title: Yahoo: Claimed by Medusa Locker, not confirmed
incidents.description: Medusa Locker claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 24 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. Hackers from MedusaLocker claim to have exfiltrated 1,511 Yahoo emails linked to the Brazilian domain yahoo.com.br and are demanding $10,000 to not publish the data. Cybernews researchers could not verify the samples and Yahoo has not confirmed the breach. Brazil.

incidents.title: Standard Nuclear: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 23 Nov 2026. Standard Nuclear, Inc. filed a Form 8-K with the SEC on 2026-11-23 that discusses a cybersecurity incident. Read the filing for scope and impact. Oak Ridge, United States.

incidents.title: CIA: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 23 Nov 2026. The United States Central Intelligence Agency reported a sophisticated cyber intrusion that targeted its open source intelligence processing system. Officials confirmed that no classified data was compromised, though attribution to the Chinese government remains unverified. Washington, United States.

incidents.title: Peninsula Energy (Lance Project): Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 23 Nov 2026. ASX-listed Peninsula Energy halted trading after a cyberattack affected operational servers at its Lance uranium project in Wyoming. The company announced the incident to the ASX on 23 November 2026 and it was reported on 24 November. Wyoming, United States.

incidents.title: Suzlon Energy: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 23 Nov 2026. Indian wind-energy company Suzlon Energy confirmed a cybersecurity incident on 23 November 2026 and reported it to CERT-In. The company said critical business applications remained unaffected and did not identify an attacker. Pune, India.

incidents.title: Snowy's Camping Goods: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 23 Nov 2026. Snowy's Camping Goods warned customers that malicious code operated on its website between October 5 and November 16, capturing names, emails, phones and passwords. The retailer discovered the code on November 16 and removed it immediately. Adelaide, Australia.

incidents.title: Decathlon: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 23 Nov 2026. A hacker using the alias 4me1 claimed to have stolen a database containing 163,646 Decathlon customer records, including email addresses and phone numbers. Decathlon confirmed that a malicious access to personal data occurred on 22 November 2026 and that no banking data or passwords were affected. Villeneuve-d'Ascq, France.

incidents.title: Quimper: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 23 Nov 2026. The city of Quimper and its intercommunal authority reported a cyberattack that compromised their internal information systems. The municipalities confirmed the breach and have engaged cybersecurity experts while no data loss has been verified. Quimper, France.

incidents.title: Todd, Hamaker & Johnson LLP: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 23 Nov 2026. The certified public accounting firm disclosed a data breach affecting at least 4,585 Texas residents, with names, addresses, Social Security numbers and financial account information exposed. The breach was disclosed to the Massachusetts regulator on November 23 and the Texas Attorney General on November 24, 2026. Lufkin, United States.
